died.name: Edward I of England
died.cause: to his son, Edward II of England, while dying during a war with Scotland
died.last_words: Carry my bones before you on your march, for the rebels will not be able to endure the sight of me, alive or dead.

died.name: Jereboam O. Beauchamp
died.cause: to his wife. Beauchamp had murdered Kentucky legislator Solomon P. Sharp to avenge his wife's honor. Beauchamp and his wife both stabbed themselves on the morning of his execution; his wife died of her wounds, while Beauchamp survived to be hanged
died.last_words: Farewell child of sorrow-Farewell child of misfortune and persecution-you are now secure from the tongue of slander-for you I have lived; for you I die.

died.name: Mary Surratt
died.cause: prior to execution by hanging after conviction for taking part in the conspiracy to assassinate Abraham Lincoln

died.name: Soapy Smith
died.desc: con artist and gangster in the American frontier
died.cause: after vigilante Frank H. Reid shot him

died.name: Arthur Conan Doyle
died.cause: spoken to his wife in their garden; he proceeded to clutch his chest and die

died.name: Ben L. Salomon
died.desc: United States Army dental officer and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: preparing to cover evacuation of wounded from aid station with M1917 Browning machine gun during the Battle of Saipan
died.last_words: I'm going to hold these guys off as long as I can. I'll see you later.

died.name: William J. O'Brien
died.desc: United States Army officer and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: during Banzai charge on his battalion at the Battle of Saipan
died.last_words: Don't give them a damned inch!

born.name: Virginia Rappe
born.desc: American model and silent film actress
born.last_words: I'm dying, I'm dying...he hurt me!
